test.name: actual_raw_metadata_pipe_current_vs_count_packets_read_only
test.kind: One ignored Windows test, root execution only. No filesystem writes, temporary media, source copies, remuxing, decoding, network or UI.
test.inputAuthority: Hold fixed ancestors and four GuardedFile read-only handles. Check exact lengths and SHA before and after using bounded128KiB scratch and restored cursors. Recover the exact native identity with recovery_identity and construct CompletedSelection through its normal proof/receipt/scan checks. Reuse its guarded visit for the same selected original UnitSpan ranges; do not invent paths, ranges, configuration or ownership.
test.comparison: For each selected unit, borrow its reader once and run the existing private run_output twice sequentially: current metadata_command; then the identical command with only -count_packets added. Keep fixed METADATA_ENTRIES, JSON64KiB, empty bounded stderr, source/tool guards, full producer hash, joined workers, contained child and exit0 unchanged. Parse every successful result through codec_facts::source against that unit's native configuration. The counted option is expected to force a complete demux read; this is a hypothesis to test, not preapproved production behavior.
test.sourceIoDiscriminant: A test-local forwarding Read+Seek wrapper records only whether the borrowed source returned an I/O error or premature EOF; it does not buffer, change reads, retain bytes or alter the runner. InputIo with no source I/O error is reported as input_io_with_source_io_ok. It does not disclose a Windows error number or establish the child's successful early exit, because current run_output intentionally does not expose those details.
test.bounds: At most16 selected units per track and64 total sequential child invocations, one child at a time; one overall240second deadline, each invocation capped by existing30second METADATA_BUDGET. No retries. ManagedProbe opens the exact managed pinned package once and is checked across every call. No arbitrary executable path or environment inheritance.
test.diagnosticFailureHandling: For the current mode only, retain the fixed InputIo result as a diagnostic observation and continue the read-only visit so full source scanning/postguards still complete. This creates no production evidence or publication capability. Unexpected faults and any counted-mode fault fail the test after normal child cleanup; final source guards/hash checks are still attempted before reporting a failure. Current-mode successes must have identical supported codec facts and exact input hash to the counted mode for the same unit.
test.output: Only bounded fixed mode/track, original unit ordinal, byte length, fixed result category, sourceIoFailed/prematureEof booleans and aggregate counts. Never print ffprobe JSON/stderr, media, paths, account information, URLs or chat. Successful comparisons do not imply codec-packet proof or a completed user recording.
test.acceptance: Counted mode succeeds with unchanged strict metadata parser and source files across every selected unit; current successes agree. If at least one current InputIo occurs with source I/O normal while counted mode succeeds, report evidence supporting the pipe-consumption hypothesis. If current mode also succeeds everywhere, report not reproduced instead of asserting a cause. Any production change requires a separate root decision and regression review.
